description: The phone's New Agent screen: a full-screen form that makes an agent (a Bot) on this phone, with its name, the model that serves it, its permission mode and what to do first.
opens: the + button in This phone's bar
the New Agent button in This phone's empty Agents list

parts.name: Bar
parts.shows: Title "New Agent" and a back button. The phone's back does the same.

parts.name: Its name
parts.shows: A card: label "Its name", a text entry with the hint "Juniper, say", and a caption: an agent here is a Bot: its name and its memory (a file in its folder) last.
text: An agent here is a Bot: its name and its memory (a file in its folder) last.

parts.name: Its model
parts.shows: Heading "Its model" and a list of radio rows, one per model the mesh serves: the model's name and "<provider> on <machine>". The first is picked until you pick another; if the picked one stops being served, the first is picked again.

states.name: none served
states.shows: "No machine in reach serves a model over an API yet (Ollama, or an OpenAI-compatible server)."

parts.name: Its permission mode
parts.shows: Heading "Its permission mode" and radio rows for each mode, Default picked at first: Default "Asks before it changes a file"; Accept Edits "Changes files in its folder without asking"; Plan "Looks only, then puts its plan to you"; Auto "Does what it needs without asking"; Don't Ask "Does only what's always allowed, never asks"; Bypass Permissions "Asks you nothing but its own questions".
text: Asks before it changes a file
Changes files in its folder without asking
Looks only, then puts its plan to you
Does what it needs without asking
Does only what's always allowed, never asks
Asks you nothing but its own questions

parts.name: What it's to do first
parts.shows: A card: label "What it's to do first" and a five-line entry with the hint "Optional".

parts.name: Error line
parts.shows: The reason it could not be made, in the destructive colour ("It couldn't be made" if none was given).

parts.name: Make Agent
parts.shows: A button "Make Agent", the primary look once a name is typed and a model is picked; "Making…" while it is asked of the phone's host.

actions.does: starts the agent on this phone with the name, model, mode and first prompt, and opens its chat; on failure shows the error line and stays

states.name: making
states.shows: The button reads "Making…" and does nothing

states.name: failed
states.shows: The error line shows the host's reason
